newsitem.title: USA: Coke Enterprises sees flat 97 EPS growth.
newsitem.headline: Coke Enterprises sees flat 97 EPS growth.

text.p: Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc said on Tuesday that it expects earnings per share growth to be flat this year but within a range of 15-20 percent in 1998.
"We expect earnings to be flat this year. And then in 1998, we expect to produce a 15-20 percent earnings per share growth rate," said spokeswoman Laura Asman.
She said the projections included the company's planned $1.66 billion purchase of Coca-Cola Beverages Ltd of Canada and Coca-Cola Bottling Co of New York.
In 1996, Coke Enterprises recorded EPS growth of about 38 percent.
